title: Bridges through time
caption: View over Vltava River, Prague, Czechia
copyright: Old town and Vltava River, Prague, Czechia (© Lara_Uhryn/Getty Images)
description: From the heights of Letná Park, visitors can enjoy one of the most iconic views of Prague, where the Vltava River winds through the heart of Czechia's capital. Framed by historic neighbourhoods and a series of elegant bridges, the scene captures centuries of architectural and cultural heritage in a single panorama. Among these crossings, the famed Charles Bridge stands out as a symbol of the city, linking Prague's past and present with its Gothic towers, stone arches and riverside statues. While it remains a favourite destination for visitors, quieter viewpoints and nearby bridges offer equally stunning perspectives of landmarks such as Prague Castle and the National Theatre, especially as the colours of fall brighten the city's riverbanks and skyline.
